d:
Bihar men bhumi adhigrahan ki prakriya tej karne ke lie alag sel aur nideshalay banega. iske lie karib 300 sthayi padon par niyukti hogi. kaibinet se prastav ko manjuri mil chuki hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
